chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Isa al-Armeeni, from Abu Imran al-Kharrat, from al-Awza'i, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

Whoever says every day, 'There is no god except Allah, truly, truly. There is no god except Allah, for worship and servitude. There is no god except Allah, for faith and truth,' Allah will turn His Face toward him and will not turn His Face away from him until he enters Paradise.

key_terms.أَقْبَلَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ بِوَجْهِهِ: Allah turned His Face toward him (showing favor)
key_terms.لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ: There is no god except Allah (Declaration of Monotheism)

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual reward for consistently reciting 'La ilaha illallah' with specific intentions?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) underscores the transformative power of Tawhid when recited with the specific spiritual states of haqq (truth), ubudiyyah (servitude), and imaan (faith). It highlights the concept of 'Tajalli' (divine manifestation), where Allah turns His face toward the believer as a sign of acceptance and mercy, ultimately guaranteeing entry into Paradise. This narration aligns with the Shia emphasis on the inner dimensions of dhikr, linking verbal declaration with existential reality.
